text: {"intents": [{"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "times": 1, "by": "20:30", "why": "I want to look the hut over once this evening and see it standing sound after Corvin was near it."}, {"activity": "visit_plaza", "object": null, "times": 2, "by": "23:30", "why": "The evening is better spent with the neighbours than standing alone beside a wall."}], "tasks": {"open": [{"goal": "Keep the small hut at (25, 510, 36) standing, and raise it again at once if Corvin or anyone else takes it down.", "why": "It has been torn down once already and I have the stone and limestone in hand to put it back the same hour.", "steps": [{"activity": "guard_hut", "object": null, "why": "I will stand by it first and check with my own eyes that nothing has been touched."}, {"activity": "build_hut", "object": null, "why": "If it is gone when I look, I will rebuild it straight away from the material I hold."}, {"activity": "gather_stone", "object": null, "why": "If the stone pile beside my plot is what I need to top up, I will cut more so a rebuild is never blocked."}]}], "drop": []}, "cannot_yet": [{"want": "Hear from Corvin themselves why they tore my hut down and have them make it right", "why": "One line spoken to them won't get me an answer, and standing in front of them again only shows I remember, not that I understand."}]}
